low_confidence_lead: I'm not entirely sure I understood — does this look right?
undo_failed: I couldn't undo "{description}" — the reverse step failed. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
unknown_intent: I'm not sure what you mean. Try "Spent $45 on lunch" or "How much on travel?"
nothing_to_confirm: Nothing is waiting for your confirmation right now. Tell me what you'd like to do.
nothing_to_cancel: Nothing to cancel — there's no action in progress.
nothing_pending: There's no action in progress right now.
employee_sensitive_refused: For privacy I can't read, change or store tax file numbers, SIN/SSN, bank or super member numbers in chat — and I haven't saved what you typed. Please update them on the employee's profile screen (Payroll → employee).
employee_none: You don't have any active employees yet. Add them on the {page} page.
employee_no_next_pay: No upcoming draft pay run yet — say "set up next pay runs" to create one.
employee_edit_unclear: I can change an employee's pay frequency or pay rate — for example "change Jane to fortnightly" or "set Jane's rate to $80k".
employee_not_found: I couldn't find that employee. Your employees: {names}.
employee_update_failed: I couldn't save that change. Please try again or edit the employee on the {page} page.
employee_updated_frequency: Done — {name}'s pay frequency changed from {from} to {to}.
employee_updated_rate: Done — {name}'s pay rate changed from {from} to {to}.
employee_next_draft_note: This applies from the next draft pay run; pay runs already processed are not changed.
employee_confirm_frequency: Change the employee's pay frequency to {frequency} (from the next draft pay run)
employee_confirm_rate: Change the employee's pay rate (from the next draft pay run)
employee_error: I couldn't load your employees. Please try again.
pay_run_drafts_review: Review and process them on the {page} page.
pay_run_drafts_processed: This pay period has already been processed — open the {page} page to review it.
pay_run_drafts_failed: I couldn't set up the draft pay runs. Please try again on the {page} page.
